For G13 and compat13.5, the size function selects mem::size_of HwDataAG13V13_5, HwDataBG13V13_5 and GlobalsG13V13_5.

Allocated/reserved extents are rounded to16KiB, but the three debug properties receive unrounded logical sizeof values. These are boot-producer calibration/global data structure sizes, not GPU firmware executable image size, full initdata aggregate size, UAT page size, or firmware-reported mailbox capacities.

Python builder stores AGXHWDataA and AGXHWDataB in RegionB fields and InitData_RegionC as regionC. The Rust global structure is the corresponding global configuration blob. Exact size agreement supports this structural comparison; constructors and field contents were not executed or compared.

Rust uses repr(C) structures with packed unaligned integer wrappers and transparent F32. Host-only compiler sizeof/alignof confirms16924/6276/74644 and alignment4 for the selected generated types; this is not an ARM64 runtime or live firmware access.
